source: Pokémon Masters EX generic trainer-class renders (asset library v1.3.0) and official Pokémon game character/class PNGs documented by PokéWiki. Eight project-original anonymous full-body illustrations were added in 0.9.1. Five non-pixel project-original full-body trainer portraits (including an Ash update) were added in 0.9.3. Three named Rocket executive portraits (Ariana, Proton and Petrel) are registered separately for story identity resolution and excluded from generic fallback selection. Twelve matching polished 2D cel-shaded trainer-class illustrations were added in 0.9.7; existing named identities remain separate.
matchPolicy: Resolve an explicitly named trainer by exact alias before considering this catalogue. Use these only for anonymous trainer-class/citizen dialogue whose role and visual age/gender are known; never assign the source costume identity as the story NPC name.
stableIdentitySelection: For a stable anonymous NPC key, hash UTF-8(gameId + NUL + actorStableId) with SHA-256, then take the first 8 digest bytes as an unsigned integer modulo the lexically sorted IDs matching the requested role/gender/age filter. Persist actorStableId across turns; do not hash dialogue text or turn number.
unavailableRequestedRoles: bug catcher (no matching Masters class art located)
